description:
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) to lead operations at a premier health and rehabilitation center located in Baltimore County, MD. This is a pivotal leadership opportunity to oversee all aspects of facility management, ensuring the highest standards of patient care, regulatory compliance, and operational efficiency.

The ideal candidate will be a visionary leader with a passion for creating a positive and supportive environment for both residents and staff. You will be instrumental in driving continuous improvement initiatives and fostering a culture of excellence within the facility. Join a team committed to making a significant impact on the lives of those we serve.
requirements: Active and unencumbered Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) license in the state of Maryland.
Minimum of 3-5 years of experience as an LNHA in a skilled nursing or rehabilitation facility.
Demonstrated knowledge of state and federal regulations governing long-term care.
Strong leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills.
Proven ability to manage budgets, staff, and facility operations effectively.
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation based on experience, ranging from $115,000 to $145,000 annually.
